ideas.why: No canonical is set anywhere and the report ties it to the sitemap origin, so it is specific and actionable.

ideas.idea: List actual routes as text on the Guides page
ideas.why: guides.vue promises graded routes but contains none, so adding real content gives readers and machines something to quote.

ideas.idea: Add more descriptive text to the home page
ideas.why: index.vue has only an h1 and a button, so a few sentences would add real content.

ideas.idea: Declare the site URL once in the Nuxt config
ideas.why: It is accurate and keeps hosts consistent, but it does little by itself without a module that uses it.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap
ideas.why: It is accurate but has little effect on a two-URL sitemap.
It is accurate and applies to almost any site, and it does little for finding or understanding the site.

ideas.idea: Note that the X-Robots-Tag header only works on a Nitro server, not on static hosting
ideas.why: This is a deployment caveat to confirm outside the code, and it doesn't change the known noindex problem.
